_readme: Evidence for FLUX 3 Video, read from Black Forest Labs' own endpoint documentation.
This is the model whose input contract maps most directly onto CineBraid's existing
reference vocabulary: up to ten keyframes, each pinned to a frame index or a
timestamp, is precisely what the sequential-keyframe and waypoint roles already mean.
That is recorded as a fact, not as a plan - nothing compiles to it yet.

identity.note: Described by the vendor as one model family behind one API, covering text-to-video, image-to-video and audio.

capabilities.note: draft_enhance is a preview-then-finish workflow, not a generation mode in CineBraid's vocabulary, and is not encoded as one.

capabilities.claim: Duration range in whole seconds, or auto.

capabilities.note: hd is the default. These are the vendor's own tokens; Runware exposes the same tiers as 720p and 1080p.

capabilities.claim: Synchronised audio is generated in the same call and is on by default.

capabilities.note: One image opens the shot; a pair interpolates; three or more are pinned to timestamps.

capabilities.claim: Video-to-video continues from the final frames of an existing clip.
Safety tolerance is a caller parameter.
A draft mode returns a cacheable preview bundle that a later full render can consume.

notEstablished.status: not documented on the vendor endpoint
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: capabilities.flags.seed is false. Runware's offering of the same model declares a seed; that is recorded against the Runware surface and produces a `declares-unestablished` divergence rather than changing the model.
constraints.fps is null; no quantiser is asserted.

notEstablished.status: the reachable documentation index is organised around FLUX 3; no FLUX.2 [pro] schema was retrieved
notEstablished.cineBraidBehaviour: flux-2/pro is catalogued at watchlist with evidenceStrength none and every constraint null.

conflicts.resolution: Both kept. Neither is promoted; the model flag stays false and the surface records its own answer.

Each layer keeps its own tokens. Translating one into the other in the catalogue would invent a mapping the vendor has not published, and the capability intersection would then compare two strings that are not the same string.
